body:
Full-codebase review, verification and packaging findings:

* The gate never exercises the release variant, which is the only minified one. `verify-all.sh` runs `:app:testDebugUnitTest :app:lintDebug`; release builds minify and shrink, so a missing keep rule for kotlinx-serialization, Retrofit or Room is invisible until the APK crashes on a user's phone — with the tag already cut. android/README.md even notes that `testReleaseUnitTest` carries the proof the debug TLS bypass is absent from release, and nothing runs it.
* The gate never builds or smoke-tests the wheel. Both scripts run only inside release.sh, i.e. after the tree has been bumped and the APK rebuilt, so a packaging regression surfaces at the worst possible moment.
* The `web_dist` package-data globs are one level deep (`web_dist/*`, `web_dist/assets/*`). Today's output is covered, but anything Vite emits in a new subdirectory — `web/public/img/`, say — is dropped from the wheel silently and passes every check. Use a recursive glob.
* `release.sh` runs `assembleRelease --offline` with no online fallback, unlike the gate, which retries online when the Gradle cache is cold; the release variant resolves R8 and the shrinker for the first time, so a cold cache fails it after the whole gate has run.
* Cutting a release needs the network, late and unpinned: `pip wheel .` uses build isolation and fetches setuptools (unpinned in pyproject), and smoke-wheel.sh installs Flask from PyPI into a throwaway venv. The root README says building a release wheel needs only Python 3.11+.
* `verify-all.sh` and `release.sh` use `npx`, which fetches from the registry when a binary is missing, so the gate can run a version other than the locked one; `release.sh` builds the shipped bundle without a preceding `npm ci`.
* bootstrap.sh downloads the Android command-line tools over TLS with no checksum and does not check that the unzip succeeded.
* The lint/format toolchain is unpinned (`black>=26.0`, `isort>=9.0`, `ruff>=0.16`, `ty>=0.0.77`) and the gate's first stage is a formatting check, so a new black release fails every checkout until someone reformats.
title: The gate never builds the release variant or the wheel, and the web_dist glob is one level deep
